actions.add_contact.description: Add a new contact to your Google Contacts.
actions.batch_create_contacts.descriptio: Create up to 200 contacts in a single call.
actions.batch_create_contacts.props.cont: Up to 200 contacts to create. Each needs at least a name, an email or a phone number.
actions.batch_delete_contacts.descriptio: Permanently delete up to 500 contacts in a single call.
actions.batch_delete_contacts.props.reso: Up to 500 opaque contact resource names such as people/c12345. Every listed contact is deleted permanently and cannot be restored.
actions.batch_get_contact_groups.descrip: Read up to 200 contact groups in one call by their resource names.
actions.batch_get_contact_groups.props.m: How many member resource names to return per group. Defaults to 0, which returns none.
actions.batch_get_contact_groups.props.r: Up to 200 opaque contact group resource names such as contactGroups/abc123, resolved with List Contact Groups.
actions.batch_get_contacts.description: Read up to 200 contacts in one call by their resource names.
actions.batch_get_contacts.props.resourc: Up to 200 opaque contact resource names such as people/c12345, resolved with List Contacts or Search Contacts.
actions.batch_update_contacts.descriptio: Update up to 200 contacts in a single call from full Person objects.
actions.batch_update_contacts.props.cont: JSON array of up to 200 full Person objects taken from Batch Get Contacts, each keeping its resourceName and etag, with the fields to change edited in place.
actions.create_contact.description: Create a new contact in the connected Google account.
actions.create_contact.props.biography.d: Free-text notes stored on the contact biography.
actions.create_contact.props.emails.desc: Array of email address strings, for example ["ada@example.com"]. A single address still has to be wrapped in an array.
actions.create_contact.props.phoneNumber: Array of phone number strings, for example ["+1 555 0100"]. A single number still has to be wrapped in an array.
actions.create_contact_group.description: Create a contact group, or return the existing one with that name.
Name of the contact group to find or create.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.delete_contact.description: Permanently delete a contact by its resource name.
actions.delete_contact.props.resourceNam: Opaque contact resource name such as people/c12345. Resolve it with List Contacts or Search Contacts. Deletion cannot be undone.
actions.delete_contact_group.props.delet: When enabled, every contact in the group is permanently deleted as well. Leave off to remove only the group.
actions.delete_contact_group.props.resou: Opaque contact group resource name such as contactGroups/abc123. Resolve it with List Contact Groups.
actions.delete_contact_photo.description: Remove the photo of an existing contact.
actions.delete_contact_photo.props.resou: Opaque contact resource name such as people/c12345. Resolve it with List Contacts or Search Contacts.
actions.get_contact.description: Read a single contact by its resource name.
actions.get_contact.props.resourceName.d: Opaque contact resource name such as people/c12345. Resolve it with List Contacts or Search Contacts.
actions.get_contact_group.description: Read one contact group, optionally with its member resource names.
actions.get_contact_group.props.maxMembe: How many member resource names to return. Defaults to 0, which returns none.
actions.get_contact_group.props.resource: Opaque contact group resource name such as contactGroups/abc123, or a system group like contactGroups/myContacts. Resolve it with List Contact Groups.
actions.list_contact_groups.description: List every contact group of the connected Google account.
actions.list_contacts.description: List the contacts of the connected Google account.
actions.list_contacts.props.maxResults.d: Maximum number of contacts to return. Defaults to 200.
actions.modify_contact_group_members.des: Add contacts to a contact group or remove them from it.
actions.modify_contact_group_members.dis: Add Or Remove Contact Group Members
actions.modify_contact_group_members.pro: Opaque contact group resource name such as contactGroups/abc123, contactGroups/myContacts or contactGroups/starred. Resolve it with List Contact Groups.
Opaque contact resource names such as people/c12345 to add to the group.
Opaque contact resource names such as people/c12345 to remove from the group.
actions.search_contact.description: Find contacts by name, email, phone number or company.
actions.search_contact.props.pageSize.de: How many contacts to return, up to 30.
actions.search_contact.props.query.descr: Matches the start of any word in a name, email, phone or company.
actions.search_contact.props.readMask.de: Contact details included in each result.
actions.search_contacts.description: Search the connected account contacts by a plain-text query.
actions.search_contacts.props.pageSize.d: Number of results to return, maximum 30. Defaults to 30.
actions.search_contacts.props.query.desc: Plain-text query prefix-matched against contact fields such as name, email and phone number.
actions.update_contact.description: Change an existing contact's details in Google Contacts.
actions.update_contact.props.etag.descri: The etag returned with the Contact ID. Fails if the contact changed.
actions.update_contact.props.resourceNam: The resourceName (people/…) from Search Contacts or Add Contact.
Each field you pick is replaced as a whole, and any part left empty is cleared. Email and Phone Number replace all of the contact's existing ones. Fields you do not pick stay as they are, even if filled in below.
actions.update_contact.props.updatePerso: Only these fields change on the contact.
actions.update_contact_fields.descriptio: Update only the supplied fields on an existing contact.
actions.update_contact_fields.props.clea: Remove every email address from the contact, including the last one. This is the only way to clear them. Cannot be combined with a non-empty Email Addresses list.
Remove every phone number from the contact, including the last one. This is the only way to clear them. Cannot be combined with a non-empty Phone Numbers list.
actions.update_contact_fields.props.emai: Array of email address strings, for example ["ada@example.com"]. Replaces every email address stored on the contact. Leaving it empty keeps the stored addresses; it does not clear them, because an untouched list and an emptied one cannot be told apart. Use Clear Email Addresses to remove them.
actions.update_contact_fields.props.phon: Array of phone number strings, for example ["+1 555 0100"]. Replaces every phone number stored on the contact. Leaving it empty keeps the stored numbers; it does not clear them, because an untouched list and an emptied one cannot be told apart. Use Clear Phone Numbers to remove them.
actions.update_contact_fields.props.reso: Opaque contact resource name such as people/c12345. Resolve it with List Contacts or Search Contacts.
actions.update_contact_group.description: Rename an existing user-created contact group.
actions.update_contact_group.props.resou: Opaque contact group resource name such as contactGroups/abc123. Resolve it with List Contact Groups.
actions.update_contact_photo.description: Set the photo of an existing contact from base64 image bytes.
actions.update_contact_photo.props.photo: Base64-encoded JPEG, PNG or WebP image. A data URL prefix is accepted and stripped.
actions.update_contact_photo.props.resou: Opaque contact resource name such as people/c12345. Resolve it with List Contacts or Search Contacts.
triggers.new_or_updated_contact.descript: Runs when a contact is added or edited in Google Contacts.
